Calculate the thermal-mismatch strain in an aluminum film bonded to a ceramic substrate after cooling by 180 K.
Use the coefficient of thermal expansion of the aluminum film: α_f = 23×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹.
Use the coefficient of thermal expansion of the ceramic substrate: α_s = 8×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹.
Use the temperature change (cooling): ΔT = 180 K.
Apply the thermal-mismatch strain formula for a bonded film on a rigid substrate: ε = (α_s - α_f) × ΔT.
Substitute values: ε = (8×10⁻⁶ - 23×10⁻⁶) × 180 = (-15×10⁻⁶) × 180 = -2.7×10⁻³.
Report the result as approximately -2700 microstrain (compressive in the film due to cooling).
